EIOTClub OpenAPI PHP SDK (PHP 8)

Overview
- This repository provides a lightweight PHP 8 SDK that wraps EIOTClub OpenAPI endpoints.
- It implements request signing, a unified client initializer, and module-based chained calls (cards/packages/pools/cloudEsim/cdr).
- Asynchronous notification handling is out of scope; the SDK only provides signature verification helpers for incoming notification payloads.

Key Concepts
- Base URL: https://oapi.eiotclub.com
- Request method: JSON POST (do not append query parameters to URL)
- System-level parameters added to every API call:
  - appkey (provided by EIOTClub)
  - timestamp (10-digit unix timestamp)
  - nonce (5-digit random integer)
  - sign (generated by the signing algorithm)
- Notification signature verification:
  - The sign calculation for notifications must NOT include appkey (only API calls include appkey).

Signing Algorithm (API Calls)
1) Sort all non-empty request params by parameter name in ASCII order.
2) Concatenate as "key=value&key2=value2&...".
3) Append "secret={secret}" to the end (secret is not part of the sort, and is not sent to the API).
4) SHA1 the final string and convert to uppercase.

Package Structure
- src/Config.php
  - Immutable SDK configuration (appKey, secret, baseUri, timeout, throwOnApiError).
- src/Signer.php
  - Sign generation and verification (including notification verification without appkey).
- src/Client.php
  - Core HTTP client: builds system params, signs payload, sends JSON POST, parses response.
  - Throws exceptions when enabled (throwOnApiError=true by default).
  - Exposes module entrypoints for chained calls.
- src/EIOTClub.php
  - Unified initializer: EIOTClub::create(appKey, secret, options) -> Client.
- src/Services/*
  - Module wrappers. Each module provides:
    - request(path, params): call arbitrary endpoint by path.
    - Some modules may include explicit endpoint wrappers (e.g., CardsService::getAllCardInfo).
- src/Exceptions/*
  - ApiException: thrown when API response code != "200" (when throwOnApiError is enabled).
  - HttpException: thrown on transport errors or invalid JSON response.
  - InvalidSignatureException: thrown when assertNotificationSignature() fails.

Usage (Quick Start)
1) Install (as a dependency in another project)
   composer require eiotclub/eiotclub-sdk

2) Initialize
   use EIOTClub\Sdk\EIOTClub;
   $client = EIOTClub::create($appKey, $secret, [
       'base_uri' => 'https://oapi.eiotclub.com',
       'timeout' => 10,
   ]);

3) Chained calls by module
   $resp = $client->cards()->getAllCardInfo(pageNum: 1, pageSize: 500);
   $resp = $client->cards()->request('/api/v3/card/getCardInfo', ['iccid' => '89860...']);

4) Notification signature verification (verify only)
   $payload = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: [];
   if (!$client->verifyNotificationSignature($payload)) {
       http_response_code(401);
       exit('invalid sign');
   }

Testing
- Install dev dependencies:
  composer install
- Run tests:
  composer test
